data: Synthetic fixtures; no personal Health records

inspected.observation: Medium-height question sheet; selected Morning remains separate from Something else; primary label has clear contrast. Lower content is scrollable behind a persistent footer.
The question is visible directly above the user answer and following response.
Million-token option selected, 1,050,000 capacity and 50,000 reply reserve visible.
Cold return opens the saved chat and displays Continue after three earlier resumptions.
Brain symbol shows a partially colored lower area next to the microphone and Send; input remains full width.
The smaller model exposes 252,000 and no million-token choice.
Chat menu contains Connections, Task activity and Inbox; Library is absent.
A fourth manual continuation finishes and removes the pending Continue card.
Health categories, selected/available count and select-all control are readable. The authorization button is disabled in this unsigned simulator build as intended.
Blood-pressure search shows the grouped, diastolic and systolic rows above the keyboard. The introduction collapses while selection count and save action stay visible.

physical_limits: Long background and locked-screen resource grants/system activity behavior
